caption: A Chukchi skin dwelling in winter, photographed by Waldemar Bogoras during the Jesup North Pacific Expedition, 1901.
alt: Black-and-white photograph of a dome-shaped fur-covered Chukchi winter dwelling on snow, with two people and sled dogs in front.
credit: American Museum of Natural History / Waldemar Bogoras, 1901
note: Not a plate from the book itself: the original 1904 AMNH Memoir volume (with its plates) is only on Internet Archive as a lending-restricted 1975 reprint (chukchee0000bogo), and no unrestricted full scan could be located. This is a field photograph Bogoras himself took on the same 1900-1901 Jesup expedition that produced the 'Religion' volume excerpted here.
